India formally maps 28 strategic Ladakh sites, including LAC friction points

The Indian government has formally marked 28 strategic locations in Ladakh on an official map. These sites include areas along the Line of Actual Control (LAC) that have been points of friction. The marking of these sites on the official map signifies their strategic importance.
